strings.name: Forrest Li
strings.summary: Forrest Li founded Sea and has served as chairman and CEO since 2009. The group operates Garena in digital entertainment, Shopee in e-commerce and Monee in digital financial services. He also chairs Lion City Sailors FC and was elected president of the Football Association of Singapore in 2025.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Birth year unconfirmed. Group founding, platform launches, rebranding and listing dates are distinguished; football offices are not coaching or playing achievements.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded Sea, expanding digital entertainment, e-commerce and financial services in Southeast Asia and influencing the regional internet economy.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Bachelor’s in Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; MBA, Stanford Graduate School of Business.
strings.facts.f2.label: Public office
strings.facts.f2.value: President of the Football Association of Singapore for the 2025–2029 term.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Digital businesses across sectors
strings.highlights.h1.text: Led the group’s expansion from digital entertainment into e-commerce, payments and other digital financial services; teams operate the businesses.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Football investment and development
strings.highlights.h2.text: Participates in club and association governance; CNA’s 2026 reporting considers new investment alongside sustainable youth development and league competitiveness.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Comments on results as chairman and CEO
strings.timeline.t1.text: Discusses Shopee and Monee business progress in Sea’s third-quarter results announcement.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Financial business renamed Monee
strings.timeline.t2.text: Sea announces SeaMoney’s rebranding and opens a new digital financial services headquarters in Singapore.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Elected Singapore football president
strings.timeline.t3.text: Elected on an unopposed slate, succeeding Bernard Tan for a term ending in 2029.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Becomes Lion City Sailors chairman
strings.timeline.t4.text: Sea announces full ownership of Home United, renamed Lion City Sailors, with Li as chairman.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Sea lists on the New York Stock Exchange
strings.timeline.t5.text: American depositary shares begin trading as SE; the initial public offering closes on October 24.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Group launches Shopee
strings.timeline.t6.text: The mobile-first e-commerce app rolls out across seven regional markets over several weeks starting in June.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Group launches AirPay
strings.timeline.t7.text: The digital payments business launches first in Vietnam, followed by Thailand that June.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Founds Sea’s predecessor
strings.timeline.t8.text: The group starts with Garena; the current company biography dates his chairmanship and CEO tenure to this point.
